        customer_id="cus_1",

    )

I implemented `issue_credit_note(invoice, amount, reason)` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`.

Key behaviors:
- Returns `{"invoice_id", "amount", "reason"}`.
- Normalizes/rounds money via `to_money`/`round_money`, rejecting non-positive amounts (`negative_amount`).
- Only `issued` invoices can be credited (`invalid_state`).
- Rejects amounts exceeding the invoice total (`amount_exceeds_total`).
- Requires a reason, max 200 chars (`reason_required` / `reason_too_long`).
- Enforces FIN-2026-03: credits above 500.00 require `approved_by` (`approval_required`).
- Supports keyword-only `idempotency_key`, checked first and passed to `audit.record`.

All 10 tests pass, and manual edge-case checks confirmed correct behavior.
